items.title: DISCOVERY OF A BURIED CRATER ON THE MOON! CHANDRAYAAN-3 VIKRAM LANDER AND PRAGYAN ROVER LANDED WITHIN IT
items.snippet_en: ISRO confirms that the Chandrayaan-3 mission, with its Vikram lander and Pragyan rover, landed in the high latitude highland region near the south pole of the Moon.

items.title: Chandrayaan-3
items.snippet_en: Chandrayaan-3 entered lunar orbit on August 5, 2023, and its Vikram lander touched down near the lunar south pole on August 23, 2023, at 18:04 IST (12:33 UTC).

items.title: How India Created History With Chandrayaan-3 Landing On The Lunar South Pole
items.snippet_en: India's Chandrayaan-3 spacecraft successfully landed on the moon's south pole region on August 23, 2023, becoming the first country to touch down in this uncharted lunar region. The Vikram lander touched down at 18:04 local time (12:34 GMT).

items.title: India becomes only the 4th country to successfully land a spacecraft on the moon
items.snippet_en: India landed a spacecraft near the moon's south pole on August 23, 2023, becoming the first country to touch down near the little-explored south pole region. India joins the United States, the Soviet Union, and China in achieving a moon landing.

items.title: India on the moon! Chandrayaan-3 lander touches down in lunar south pole region
items.snippet_en: India's Vikram lander, part of the Chandrayaan-3 mission, touched down near the lunar south pole on August 23, 2023, at 8:33 a.m. EDT (1233 GMT; 6:03 p.m. IST). India has become the fourth country to successfully land a robotic spacecraft on the moon.

items.title: India Moon landing: Chandrayaan-3 spacecraft lands near south pole
items.snippet_en: India's Moon mission became the first to land in the lunar south pole region on August 23, 2023, with the Vikram lander from Chandrayaan-3 successfully touching down at 18:04 local time (12:34 GMT).
